title: Givodo
summary: I started a perfume venture in India.
alt: Amber perfume bottle on burgundy stone.
intro: I wanted to see if there was room for a perfume brand between everyday and luxury prices. Givodo gave me a chance to see how a product goes from an idea to something you can actually make.
highlights: Compared brands in the ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 range and looked at what customers wanted.
Spoke to perfume oil suppliers, manufacturers, packaging vendors and bottle dealers.
Worked through early product development, branding and delivery.

title: BizForHer
summary: I helped run a business case competition that reached 1,700+ participants.
alt: Two presenters on a stage facing the audience.
role: Strategic and Tech Head · February to December 2025
intro: BizForHer is a business case competition for girls. I helped students find the event and sign up, and worked on the website during the competition.
highlights: Reached out to schools, companies and partners across India.
Worked with Unstop on sign-ups, participant data and running the event.
Helped the competition reach more than 1,700 participants. The event offered over ₹20 lakh in cash prizes, plus scholarships.

title: Equity research
summary: How I research a stock before deciding whether to invest.
alt: Stock chart and pencil on a desk.
intro: I spend time going through company financials and keeping up with market news. Stock pitch competitions gave me a chance to explain why I thought a company was worth investing in.
highlights: Use valuation and momentum to find stocks worth a closer look.
Built a discounted cash flow (DCF) model and investment thesis for the Ascend Berkeley Stock Pitch Competition.
Placed first globally in the competition, which had more than 300 teams.

title: Roblox Studio
summary: The Roblox games I’ve built have had 8,000+ visits.
alt: Low-poly game scene with a path between purple rock walls.
intro: I like building maps and working out how the game plays. I’ve also taken on low-poly and mid-poly design commissions.
highlights: Built maps, menus, controls, rewards and game logic in Roblox Studio.
My Roblox games have had more than 8,000 visits.
Placed second in a national inter-school game development competition.
